⚖️ Legal, Licensing & DPDP Privacy
🔒 DPDP Act 2023 & Guest Privacy COMPLIANT

• Data Fiduciary: The host wedding family acts as the Data Fiduciary. WeddingCraft provides technical processing only.

• Purpose Limitation: Guest RSVP submissions, names, phone numbers, and dietary preferences are collected solely for ceremony coordination, seating, and digital entry pass delivery.

• Zero Third-Party Commercial Tracking: No tracking cookies, no cross-site ad profiling, and zero sale/monetization of guest contact numbers to data brokers.

• Right to Erasure: Guests may request complete removal of their RSVP submission by contacting the wedding host or platform grievance officer.

📜 Open Source & Fonts Licensing AUDITED

• Typography: Google Fonts (Tiro Devanagari Hindi, Yatra One, Playfair Display, Cinzel Decorative) licensed under the permissive SIL Open Font License 1.1.

• QR Code Engine: Kazuhiko Arase's QR Generator (MIT License), eliminating all GPL copyleft obligations on commercial packages.

• Audio Heritage: Traditional Shehnai recordings sourced from CC0/Public Domain cultural preservation archives.

🎭 Personality Rights & Demo Archetypes SAFEGUARDED

• Showcase themes and celebrity archetype demos are synthetic editorial prototypes for layout demonstration only, not affiliated with or endorsed by any living person.

• Real client wedding websites are published strictly pursuant to client onboarding waivers and explicit family authorization.
